function_revised: Membrane protein (16.6 kDa) of the cell envelope implicated in host-cell invasion; a dimorphic antigen carrying a Beijing-genotype-specific Asn142Lys polymorphism with distinct antibody responses. Rv0679c-derived peptides bind A549/U937 cells and TLR2/TLR4 and inhibit bacillary entry, suggesting a role in invasion (Zhao 2017). Molecular function unfixed.
evidence: Membrane protein; invasion-inhibiting binding peptides; dimorphic Beijing N142K antigen (Zhao 2017, PMID 28506215)
Curated from the literature crible (project 'Still unknown gene function', 2026-06-09)
